About Garv Gold

A legacy of steel craftsmanship running since 1994, now in its third generation.

Garv Gold stands as a name for quality and craftsmanship in the utensils manufacturing industry, established in 1994 by Mr. Virendra Kumar Jain. Today, under the leadership of Mr. Nitin Jain and Mr. Sachin Jain, Garv Gold continues that legacy of superior quality, innovative design and customer-first service — manufactured under our company Nitin Steels. The third generation, Mr. Hirim Jain, now works alongside the second generation, carrying the same standard of craftsmanship forward.

Our product line spans premium stainless steel hotpots, casseroles, tiffins, storage pawalis, buckets and dinner sets — every piece made from high quality stainless steel coil and finished for durability, safety and everyday performance. Our sister brand, Lotus Lite, extends the same standard of quality across its own range.

02

Coil to Utensil

The same stages, every batch — order is what keeps the finish consistent.

01

Coil Selection

High quality stainless steel coil is checked for gauge consistency and surface quality before it enters production.

02

Cutting & Forming

Coil is cut and pressed into shape — hotpots, casseroles, tiffins and buckets — under controlled tooling for a leakproof, crack-resistant body.

03

PUF Insulation

Hot & cold products are fitted with PUF insulation and a stainless steel interior to hold temperature for hours, not minutes.

04

Polishing & Finishing

Every piece is buffed to a mirror finish and edge-finished for safe, comfortable handling.

05

Inspection & Packing

A final quality pass checks finish and fit before pieces are boxed for retail or bulk dispatch.

03
